articles.title: NEAR Intents says its identified the hacker, gives 48-hour ultimatum
articles.description: “We have identified you, sir,” NEAR Intents general manager Alex Shevchenko said on Friday after the protocol was hacked for $3.8 million.

articles.title: SEC moves to clear custody hurdle for advisers offering crypto
articles.description: Custody requirements have kept some investment advisers from offering certain crypto to clients, a regulatory hurdle the SEC’s proposal could remove.

articles.title: China warns foreign spies about crypto, Singapore dominates Asia: Asia Express
articles.description: Singapore’s crypto economy grows 55%, South Korea set to make crypto market makers legal, and Chinese spy ministry warns would-be foreign spies it’s watching the blockchain.

articles.title: Evernorth clears shareholder vote ahead of Nasdaq debut with 473M XRP treasury
articles.description: Evernorth expects to begin trading on Nasdaq under the ticker XRPN after its SPAC merger closes, with an XRP treasury worth roughly $710 million at current prices.

articles.title: Trump to host 3rd ‘exclusive’ memecoin event amid corruption claims
articles.description: The president is scheduled to appear at his golf club in Washington, DC, at a Nov. 22 dinner for his top 185 memecoin holders, following similar events in May 2025 and April 2026.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: 50,000 Europeans call on EU to ease stablecoin rewards restrictions in MiCA review
articles.description: A 50,000-letter campaign is pressing Brussels to rethink stablecoin rewards as EU central banks seek broader changes to MiCA’s stablecoin rules.

articles.title: Illinois will postpone implementation of crypto tax following lawsuit
articles.description: State officials agreed to delay the 0.2% crypto tax for six months after lawsuits and industry pushback claimed the bill was rushed through the legislature.

articles.title: New York, Wyoming regulators sign pact to coordinate crypto oversight
articles.description: The agreement will allow the two state regulators to share supervisory information, streamline licensing reviews and coordinate examinations and enforcement actions involving digital asset firms.

articles.title: Bitcoin fights for local uptrend as US bond yields drop from new 24-year highs
articles.description: US bond yields fell sharply around Thursday’s Wall Street open as Bitcoin price action sought to preserve a local trend of higher lows.

articles.title: NEAR Intents suffers $3.8M exploit after assistance with Bitget breach
articles.description: The platform said it will compensate users affected by the hack, which stemmed from a bug that affected deposits and withdrawals.

articles.title: Bitget’s $388M hack pushes Q3 crypto security losses past $1B
articles.description: Crypto security losses reached $1.26 billion in Q3 across 247 incidents, with September alone accounting for roughly $769 million.

articles.title: LATAM stablecoin liquidity may depend on few providers, investor says
articles.description: Researchers in a Latin American stablecoin ecosystem report warned “fragility in the system is concentrated in its thinnest layer,” with just 16 of 494 companies focused primarily on wholesale liquidity, treasury and credit.

articles.title: Stablecoins can drain from banks and nations at lightning speed
articles.description: Highly liquid and settling 24/7, stablecoins can leave banks and countries at lightning speed. But whether stablecoins are a risk — or an opportunity — depends on your perspective.

articles.title: Tokenized assets don’t always mirror traditional markets, Dune finds
articles.description: Dune found that tokenized markets show different trading patterns from traditional markets, with RWA value reaching $34.5 billion.

articles.title: Bitcoin trapped below $86K as PCE changes cloud inflation reading
articles.description: Bitcoin erased its post-PCE gains as analysts cautioned that methodology changes complicated the lower-than-expected inflation reading.

articles.title: Binance’s EU services face scrutiny over licensing exemption: Report
articles.description: EU regulators are reportedly examining Binance’s use of a MiCA exemption to serve customers as ESMA seeks stronger enforcement powers.

articles.title: Chainalysis beats most Celsius claims, but ‘audit’ lawsuit survives
articles.description: Chainalysis still faces an aiding-and-abetting claim over Celsius’ disputed $3.3 billion audit after a judge dismissed 15 other claims.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs draw $6.3B in Q3 as BTC price rises nearly 43%
articles.description: Bitcoin gained 42.71% in Q3, its best third-quarter performance since 2017, as US spot ETFs attracted $6.34 billion in net inflows.

articles.title: Bitcoin think tank questions MSCI’s ‘invisible committee’ over Strategy, Metaplanet rule
articles.description: A Bitcoin Policy Institute paper says MSCI’s proposed “non-operating company” rule could remove Strategy and Metaplanet from its indexes and may have roots in an earlier crypto treasury review.

articles.title: Crypto hacks top $768M in September, worst month of 2026
articles.description: The $388 million Bitget breach and $320 million Liquid Network exploit accounted for most of September’s losses, though more than $270 million from the latter was later returned.

articles.title: CFTC seeks to define event contracts as swaps amid prediction market fight
articles.description: The classification could assist the CFTC’s claim that it has exclusive federal jurisdiction over event contracts offered on regulated prediction markets.

articles.title: MetaMask exits Ethereum validators amid undisclosed security incident
articles.description: MetaMask said it is investigating the threat internally and said it has found no immediate threat to its wallets.

articles.title: Standard Chartered sees Ethena’s USDe reaching $40B, ENA hitting $2
articles.description: The bank also expects Ethena’s ENA token to rise roughly sevenfold to $2 by the end of 2028 as USDe scales and token buybacks increase.

articles.title: Crypto advocacy group announces picks for US Congress as midterms loom
articles.description: The organization’s endorsements in the House and Senate came as many polls showed Democrats favored to regain control of both chambers in 2027.

articles.title: Base completes Cobalt upgrade, adds new tools for tokenized assets
articles.description: Base’s Cobalt lets traders set transaction conditions while giving issuers tools for compliance checks, stock splits and forced token transfers.

articles.title: Bloomberg brings onchain stablecoin data to its Terminal
articles.description: Bloomberg’s Allium-powered dashboard gives Terminal users hourly data on stablecoin supply, issuance, transfers and activity across blockchain networks.

articles.title: Brazil’s Petrobras uses Cardano to track sustainable aviation fuel, renewable diesel
articles.description: Petrobras developed two Cardano-based applications to track sustainability claims tied to aviation fuel and renewable diesel as part of an ongoing research collaboration.

articles.title: Bitget ‘gradually back to usual’ as protection fund reaches $309M
articles.description: Bitget CEO Gracy Chen said that a protection fund created by the company in 2022 “absorbed the financial impact of the incident“ that resulted in $388 million in user losses.

articles.title: Could THORChain face prosecution over stolen Bitget funds? Legal opinion
articles.description: THORChain will not — or can not — block addresses linked to the $387.5 million Bitget hack. Can the devs be prosecuted for money laundering? It’s complicated, says crypto lawyer Yuriy Brisov.
